steps.description: Parse input data and build data structures for jobs, operations, machines, downtimes and policy
Determine precedence-aware repair order: sort operations by (index, baseline start, base index)
Implement overlap detection using half-open intervals [s,e)

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Use half-open intervals [s,e): correct formula is 's < b and a < e'. Using <= incorrectly flags adjacent intervals as overlapping.

suggestions: Overlap check for intervals [a,b) and [s,e): return s < b and a < e — never use <=.

steps.description: Implement has_conflict to check machine timeline and downtime conflicts
Implement earliest_feasible_time with incremental forward scan (t += 1) from anchor

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Must scan forward incrementally (t += 1) from anchor — jumping or binary-searching breaks the minimality requirement.

suggestions: Scan: while has_conflict(m, t, t+dur): t += 1 — find the earliest slot, not just any feasible slot.

steps.description: Repair operations in precedence-aware order; record ALL operations in machine_intervals including frozen ones

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Even frozen operations MUST be appended to machine_intervals. Skipping them causes later operations to overlap with frozen ones.

warnings: Always call machine_intervals[m].append((start, end)) for ALL operations — including frozen ones.
